title: YC-backed healthtech startup BioStack raises $9.5 million from Peak XV, DCVC, others
summary: YC-backed healthtech startup BioStack raises $9.5 million from Peak XV, DCVC, others
detailed: The Y Combinator-backed startup, which operates across India, the US, Brazil and Argentina, has access to more than 100 million de-identified patient records.
